items.title: ⚡ Flash Heard: Texas Data Center U-Turn Hits Power Stocks
items.summary: Abundant natural gas, lots of land and a supportive political environment were all reasons why data centers had been flocking to Texas.  On Monday afternoon, Texas Governor Greg Abbott directed the state’s grid operator and utility regulator to conduct a “comprehensive verification and audit” of all data centers asking for interconnection, and said no additional data centers can be approved until that process is completed.  This puts a pause on a new process—named Batch Zero—that Texas greenlighted in June to fast-track interconnection requests from data centers.
